recommendation_summary: Recommends building a small local tool this week. It would read the client's ordered code list, match JPEG filename prefixes exactly, flag missing, unmatched or duplicate files, and produce a contact-sheet PDF and manifest in the client's order. The plan is to validate it on a past delivery before using it on a live job. It says AI tagging and semantic search won't help with ordering, and leaves any DAM to a separate later assessment, so nothing is added now. It asks what format the code list arrives in and for example codes and filenames.
note: Bounded local code-order fix with the DAM deferred, but none of the four required record labels appear.
